requires_external_validation.scope: Obtain external proof/priority review of the classification, exact heat identity and quantitative corollaries. For greater mathematical leverage, prove inclusion of the entire nine-coefficient acoustic rank-one cone in a valid closed heat-certificate cone, or acquire a rigorous separating obstruction and then a new compatibility mechanism. A failed heat ansatz alone would not refute quasiconvexity. Do not keep searching for a compatible negative Jensen field for the now-certified Fstar or its coefficient cube.
